Access by resource type:
SELECT data.kind AS kind, count(DISTINCT session_id) AS sessions
FROM audit.limen.events_raw WHERE from_iso8601_timestamp("time") > current_timestamp - INTERVAL '1' DAY AND dt BETWEEN format_datetime((current_timestamp - INTERVAL '1' DAY), 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND format_datetime(current_timestamp, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND kind = 'session.start' AND data.kind IN ('postgres', 'redis', 'ssh')
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
Active sessions:
SELECT count(*) AS active FROM (
  SELECT session_id FROM audit.limen.events_raw WHERE from_iso8601_timestamp("time") > current_timestamp - INTERVAL '1' DAY AND dt BETWEEN format_datetime((current_timestamp - INTERVAL '1' DAY), 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND format_datetime(current_timestamp, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND kind IN ('session.start', 'session.end') AND session_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY session_id HAVING count_if(kind = 'session.end') = 0
)
Bot sessions by repository:
SELECT coalesce(data.ci.repository, data.ci.project_path, "user") AS source, "user" AS bot, count(DISTINCT session_id) AS sessions,
  max(from_iso8601_timestamp("time")) AS last_session, max_by(data.ci.run_id, from_iso8601_timestamp("time")) AS last_run
FROM audit.limen.events_raw WHERE from_iso8601_timestamp("time") > current_timestamp - INTERVAL '1' DAY AND dt BETWEEN format_datetime((current_timestamp - INTERVAL '1' DAY), 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND format_datetime(current_timestamp, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND kind = 'session.start' AND data.actor_type = 'bot'
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY sessions DESC LIMIT 100
Connections per resource type:
SELECT date_trunc('hour', from_iso8601_timestamp("time")) AS time, data.kind AS metric, count(DISTINCT session_id) AS value
FROM audit.limen.events_raw WHERE from_iso8601_timestamp("time") > current_timestamp - INTERVAL '1' DAY AND dt BETWEEN format_datetime((current_timestamp - INTERVAL '1' DAY), 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND format_datetime(current_timestamp, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND kind = 'session.start' AND data.kind IN ('postgres', 'redis', 'ssh')
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
Failed and denied attempts:
SELECT max(from_iso8601_timestamp("time")) AS last_seen, coalesce("user", '(unknown)') AS "user", data.action AS action,
  data.resource AS resource, data.login AS login, data.reason AS reason, count(DISTINCT event_id) AS attempts
FROM audit.limen.events_raw WHERE from_iso8601_timestamp("time") > current_timestamp - INTERVAL '1' DAY AND dt BETWEEN format_datetime((current_timestamp - INTERVAL '1' DAY), 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND format_datetime(current_timestamp, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND kind = 'auth.denied'
GROUP BY 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 ORDER BY last_seen DESC LIMIT 200
Ingestion lag by producer:
SELECT producer.component AS component, producer.instance_id AS instance,
  to_unixtime(current_timestamp) - to_unixtime(max(from_iso8601_timestamp("time"))) AS lag_seconds
FROM audit.limen.events_raw WHERE from_iso8601_timestamp("time") > current_timestamp - INTERVAL '1' DAY AND dt BETWEEN format_datetime((current_timestamp - INTERVAL '1' DAY), 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND format_datetime(current_timestamp, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY lag_seconds DESC
Limen: audit events missing: SELECT coalesce(sum(missing), 0) AS value FROM (SELECT max(producer.seq) - min(producer.seq) + 1 - count(DISTINCT producer.seq) AS missing FROM audit.limen.events_raw WHERE dt >= format_datetime(current_timestamp - INTERVAL '1' DAY, 'yyyy-MM-dd') GROUP BY producer.instance_id)
Limen: audit ingestion stalled: SELECT coalesce(to_unixtime(current_timestamp) - to_unixtime(max(from_iso8601_timestamp("time"))), 0) AS value FROM audit.limen.events_raw WHERE dt >= format_datetime(current_timestamp - INTERVAL '1' DAY, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
Limen: spike in denied access: SELECT count(DISTINCT event_id) AS value FROM audit.limen.events_raw WHERE kind = 'auth.denied' AND from_iso8601_timestamp("time") > current_timestamp - INTERVAL '10' MINUTE AND dt >= format_datetime(current_timestamp - INTERVAL '1' DAY, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
Logins and denials:
SELECT date_trunc('minute', from_iso8601_timestamp("time")) AS time, kind AS metric, count(DISTINCT event_id) AS value
FROM audit.limen.events_raw WHERE from_iso8601_timestamp("time") > current_timestamp - INTERVAL '1' DAY AND dt BETWEEN format_datetime((current_timestamp - INTERVAL '1' DAY), 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND format_datetime(current_timestamp, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND kind IN ('auth.login', 'auth.denied')
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
Missing events (sequence gaps):
SELECT producer.instance_id AS instance, min(producer.seq) AS first_seq, max(producer.seq) AS last_seq,
  max(producer.seq) - min(producer.seq) + 1 - count(DISTINCT producer.seq) AS missing
FROM audit.limen.events_raw WHERE from_iso8601_timestamp("time") > current_timestamp - INTERVAL '1' DAY AND dt BETWEEN format_datetime((current_timestamp - INTERVAL '1' DAY), 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND format_datetime(current_timestamp, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY missing DESC
Policy changes:
SELECT from_iso8601_timestamp("time") AS time, "user" AS author, data.version AS version, data.digest AS digest, data.source_ref AS source_ref
FROM audit.limen.events_raw WHERE from_iso8601_timestamp("time") > current_timestamp - INTERVAL '1' DAY AND dt BETWEEN format_datetime((current_timestamp - INTERVAL '1' DAY), 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND format_datetime(current_timestamp, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND kind = 'policy.change'
ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 50
Privileged commands:
SELECT from_iso8601_timestamp("time") AS time, "user", data.login AS login, data.resource AS resource, data.command AS command, session_id
FROM audit.limen.events_raw WHERE from_iso8601_timestamp("time") > current_timestamp - INTERVAL '1' DAY AND dt BETWEEN format_datetime((current_timestamp - INTERVAL '1' DAY), 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND format_datetime(current_timestamp, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND kind = 'ssh.exec'
  AND (data.login = 'root' OR regexp_like(data.command, '(^|[;&|[:space:]])(sudo|su|doas|pkexec|chmod|chown|passwd|useradd|usermod|visudo)([[:space:]]|$)'))
ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 200
Resource type variable: SELECT DISTINCT data.kind AS kind FROM audit.limen.events_raw WHERE kind = 'session.start' AND data.kind IS NOT NULL AND dt >= format_datetime(current_timestamp - INTERVAL '30' DAY, 'yyyy-MM-dd') ORDER BY 1
Resource types in use:
SELECT data.kind AS kind, count(DISTINCT session_id) AS sessions, count(DISTINCT "user") AS users,
  count(DISTINCT data.resource) AS resources, max(from_iso8601_timestamp("time")) AS last_connection
FROM audit.limen.events_raw WHERE from_iso8601_timestamp("time") > current_timestamp - INTERVAL '1' DAY AND dt BETWEEN format_datetime((current_timestamp - INTERVAL '1' DAY), 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND format_datetime(current_timestamp, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND kind = 'session.start' AND data.kind IN ('postgres', 'redis', 'ssh')
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY sessions DESC
Sessions by actor:
SELECT date_trunc('hour', from_iso8601_timestamp("time")) AS time, coalesce(data.actor_type, 'user') AS metric, count(DISTINCT session_id) AS value
FROM audit.limen.events_raw WHERE from_iso8601_timestamp("time") > current_timestamp - INTERVAL '1' DAY AND dt BETWEEN format_datetime((current_timestamp - INTERVAL '1' DAY), 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND format_datetime(current_timestamp, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND kind = 'session.start'
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
Top users:
SELECT "user", count(DISTINCT session_id) AS sessions
FROM audit.limen.events_raw WHERE from_iso8601_timestamp("time") > current_timestamp - INTERVAL '1' DAY AND dt BETWEEN format_datetime((current_timestamp - INTERVAL '1' DAY), 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND format_datetime(current_timestamp, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND kind = 'session.start' AND "user" IS NOT NULL AND coalesce(data.actor_type, 'user') = 'user'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 15
Who accessed what:
SELECT "user", coalesce(data.actor_type, 'user') AS actor, data.resource AS resource, data.login AS login, count(DISTINCT session_id) AS sessions,
  max(from_iso8601_timestamp("time")) AS last_access
FROM audit.limen.events_raw WHERE from_iso8601_timestamp("time") > current_timestamp - INTERVAL '1' DAY AND dt BETWEEN format_datetime((current_timestamp - INTERVAL '1' DAY), 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND format_datetime(current_timestamp, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND kind = 'session.start'
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4 ORDER BY last_access DESC LIMIT 200
